coordinates.note: Same convention as src/characters/skeleton.js. Feet at y=0, rest pose = skeleton.js rest (arms down, Arm rot z +-0.1, ForeArm rot x -0.08).

loading.textures: not embedded; build materials from this manifest (see sandbox-human/lib/humanMaterials.js)
loading.binding: Each GLB carries its own copy of HumanRig (identical bone names and rest). Rebind clothes/interior SkinnedMeshes to the body skeleton by bone name (sandbox-human/lib/humanLoader.js).

rig.segmentSource: Winter 2009 Table 4.1 (Dempster) segment mass fractions; head_neck carried by Head

skin.toneParam: 0 = light, 0.5 = mid, 1 = dark (blend between the three MakeHuman albedos of the same age/sex)
skin.hideAttribute: _hide (float bitmask per body vertex; bit = clothes.items[k].hideBit). Discard skin fragments whose mask & (OR of worn items bits) != 0 to stop poke-through.
skin.note: Body back faces render as the subcutaneous fat colour so cuts read as skin over fat.

hair.colorParam: linear-ish sRGB multiplier on a neutral grey hair texture

outfitRules.note: Pick per slot with probability p from weighted options; an item listing extra slots in "covers" fills them too. sex-restricted items are skipped for the other sex except in weird mode. Items with hidesHair hide the hair mesh.

swimwearSet.note: "beach" preset = only swimwear for the sex (+ optional beanie in weird mode)

clothes.cloSource: ASHRAE 55-2020 Table B-2 / ISO 9920 garment insulation (approx.; cloEstimated=true where no table entry fits)

leg_anterior_r.anatomicalName: Anterior and lateral leg muscles (tibialis anterior, extensors, fibulares).r

leg_anterior_l.anatomicalName: Anterior and lateral leg muscles (tibialis anterior, extensors, fibulares).l

bone.note: cut: cortical rim (cutRim) around red marrow/cancellous core

interior.note: Mesh nodes are named by part id; anatomical names are here and in node extras.anatomical_name. Masses: fitted mesh volume x tissue density (approx.); refMassKg: ICRP Publication 89 reference adult values (approx.).
